en.name: Marcellinus
en.summary: A pope whose reign was engulfed by the outbreak of the Diocletianic persecution, the most severe and systematic campaign against Christians in Roman history.
en.body: Marcellinus's later years in office coincided with the beginning of the Diocletianic persecution in 303, which ordered the destruction of churches and scriptures and the arrest of clergy who refused to sacrifice to the Roman gods. A persistent and controversial later tradition claims Marcellinus himself briefly complied by handing over sacred texts or offering incense before repenting; the claim was influential enough that it was later invoked, inaccurately, in disputes over papal authority, but its historical accuracy remains disputed among scholars.
